stories.title: 60-second one-take catch-up
stories.prompt: Stories don't split at 15s anymore — film one unedited 60-second front-camera catch-up about your week, like a voice note to the gc. Comments on.

stories.title: Swipe-up sticker play
stories.prompt: Use the new swipe-up-to-add-sticker gesture mid-story and mention it ('did you know you could do this?') — early-feature content always reads as chronically online in the best way.

reels.concept: Mid-month photo dump reel on a cozy autumn audio — first fall content of the year lands hard the week people start feeling it. Schedule as a Trial Reel.
